title: Intoxicated man's death in custody being reviewed by provincial team
article: The death of an intoxicated Blood Tribe man in police custody is being reviewed by the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team.
The 48-year-old man was arrested on Tuesday and taken into custody by the Blood Tribe Police Service.
The man was arrested around 9 p.m. Tuesday while intoxicated and for a breach of recognizance, according to police.
Early the next morning, he was found dead in the cell when police checked on him.
The dead man's identity is being withheld by police until after an autopsy.
